userscript.title: Use Diffwise embedded on github.com
userscript.intro: The userscript adds a Diffwise drawer directly to pull request pages on github.com, with grouped files and summaries, so you don't have to switch tabs.
userscript.install: Install the Diffwise userscript. Your manager asks you to confirm.
userscript.open: Open any pull request on github.com and click the {tab} tab next to "Files changed".
userscript.ai: github.com blocks the requests AI analysis needs, so the drawer shows analyses shared as PR comments. Open the PR on Diffwise to run a new one.

bookmarklet.title: Jump between github.com and Diffwise
bookmarklet.intro: A bookmarklet is a bookmark that runs a small script. It works in any browser, with no extension to install, and opens the page you are on in the other site.
bookmarklet.bar: Show your bookmarks bar, for example with {shortcut}.
bookmarklet.drag: Drag this button onto the bookmarks bar:
bookmarklet.use: On a pull request, commit or compare page on github.com, click the bookmark to open it on Diffwise. Click it again to go back.
